headline: Pick of the Week

highlights: Rising retail participation, increasing financial savings, digital adoption and deeper capital markets provide a long runway for trading, listing and data-related revenue growth.  Diversified revenue streams beyond trading volumes: Apart from transaction charges, NSE earns revenues from listings, clearing & settlement, connectivity, colocation services, market data feeds and index licensing.

Non- transaction technology and data businesses provide recurring revenue streams and enhance earnings stability.  Highly scalable business with superior profitability; Resilient performance during 2QFY27: NSE operates a technology-led platform business with significant operating leverage.

Despite regulatory-related charges, it generated EBITDA margins of 67.6% and PAT margins of 62.1% in FY26, while delivering RoE of 33%, highlighting the strength of its franchise and cash-generating ability.
Despite moderation in trading volumes during Q2FY27, NSE reported a resilient performance with revenue from operations growing 11% YoY to Rs 4,067 cr, while PAT increased 23% YoY to Rs 2,578 cr.
valuation: EBITDA and PAT margins improved significantly to 76% and 56%, respectively, from 40% and 39% in Q2FY26.  Multiple growth levers through new products and global expansion: NSE is expanding into new segments such as electricity futures, commodity products, international operations through NSEIX at GIFT City, and data monetization opportunities.

During 2QFY27, NSE witnessed rapid traction in mutual fund transactions (+155% YoY), currency derivatives (+150% YoY), tri-party repo (+153% YoY), listing services (+70% YoY) and market data businesses, reducing reliance on a single revenue stream.  Reasonable Valuation: At CMP, the stock is trading at a P/E multiple of 42.3x/37.1x for FY27E/FY28E respectively, based on Bloomberg consensus estimates.
watch: With over 137 million registered investors, 3,099+ listed entities, and dominant market shares across key trading segments, NSE is a critical pillar of India's capital market infrastructure.
Key risk: Regulatory risks; Dependence on market activity; Technology and cybersecurity risk National Stock Exchange Of India Ltd.
